title: Law 3A Isolation: 8x Width & 6x Mass Disparity (G = Identity)
intuition: Eliminates Law 1 completely via parameterless G = nn.Identity() over a direct 512-particle cloud and verifies Law 2 via a smooth SiLU critic (critic_grad_med <= 1.0), isolating pure Law 3A W1 ray-length non-identifiability across an 8x mode-width ratio (sigma = [0.04..0.32]) and 6x mass ratio.
failure_mode: Pure 1-Lipschitz adversarial gradients lack width sensitivity, causing the wide sigma=0.32 mode to shrink or misallocate mass even with zero generator topology distortion.
protocol_notes: Tier-1 stretch benchmark and Four Laws Adherence Law 3 anchor (G = nn.Identity, 800 updates).
